recognize_zh: 淋巴結 IgG4 免疫染色下，許多漿細胞呈強細胞質陽性，散在或成小群分布於淋巴球之間；與 IgG 染色對照，IgG4 陽性細胞比例偏高（IgG4/IgG >40%），支持 IgG4 豐富的漿細胞浸潤。
features: Numerous plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic IgG4 staining and eccentric unstained nuclei
Positive cells scattered singly and in small clusters throughout the interfollicular tissue
Density of IgG4+ cells high enough to be counted per high-power field on comparison with the IgG stain
Background small lymphocytes negative; minimal nonspecific background staining
describe_en: IgG4 immunostain of the lymph node shows numerous IgG4-positive plasma cells distributed singly and in small clusters among negative small lymphocytes. Compared with the companion IgG stain, the IgG4:IgG ratio exceeds 40%. Findings indicate an increase in IgG4-positive plasma cells; this is supportive of, but not specific for, IgG4-related disease and must be interpreted with the clinical context, here a patient with systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Requires correlation with clinical, serologic and other organ findings, because increased IgG4+ plasma cells alone are not diagnostic.
Castleman disease may show increased IgG4+ cells but has characteristic follicular changes, sheets of plasma cells and systemic inflammation with high IL-6/CRP.
Rosai-Dorfman disease can harbor many IgG4+ plasma cells but is defined by S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
Neoplastic plasma cells are light-chain restricted on kappa/lambda ISH, whereas IgG4-rich reactive plasma cells are polytypic.
